skill: M07 裂地重踏（蝠妖精英）

parameters.prompt: The exact upright bat warrior in the reference performs ONE heavy ground stomp in place. From the resting pose it slowly lifts its right clawed leg high with the knee bent and keeps the large wings half folded behind the shoulders, then slams the foot down hard, the whole body dropping into a low wide stance with both clawed hands clenched, holds the low impact pose briefly, then straightens and calmly returns to the exact original standing pose and holds it. The wings stay close to the body and never spread wide. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Exactly two arms and two legs. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. Keep the same three-quarter left view, bat head and ears, grey fur, wings, kilt and belt. No jump, flying, punch, walking, turning, extra limbs, weapon, glow, energy, magic effects, dust, rocks, cracks, particles, shadow or text. Motion beats: first second and a half lift the leg, a sudden stomp around two seconds, then recover and hold the original pose.
